_about: The documented defaults for invest.json (AGENTS.md Rule 0): used for any key that is missing or invalid there. Ships equal to invest.json; scripts/test_invest_config.py keeps the two equal. Edit invest.json, not this.

headings.observations: ## Observations (from the source named on each line)
headings.interpretation: ## Interpretation (mine, not a fact and not advice)

brief.background: Background, not advice: one company's price can swing a lot day to day (volatility); spreading money across many holdings (diversification) means no single swing decides the outcome; fees compound against you over years; and the longer the time horizon, the more room there is to ride out falls. None of this says what you should buy.

store.unreadable: {name} is unreadable ({error}); I haven't changed it
store.bad_shape: {name} isn't in the shape I expect ({why}); I haven't changed it -- fix or move {path} and I'll start again
store.would_be_invalid: the change would leave {name} invalid ({why}), so I didn't save it
store.busy: the watchlist is busy in another window; try again
store.no_instruments: it has no list of instruments
store.not_alert_state: it isn't a record of sent alerts
store.bad_delivered: its list of sent alerts is invalid
store.bad_sent_time: a sent-alert entry has no valid time
store.bad_pending: it isn't a valid pending choice

provider.no_price: no valid price in the response
provider.bad_price: the price in the response is invalid
provider.no_market_date: no valid market date in the response
provider.future_date: market date {market} is after the exchange's today ({today})

watchlist.list_unreadable: I can't read your watchlist, so I haven't listed or changed anything: {error}.
watchlist.add_no_query: Tell me the ticker to watch, with its exchange suffix if it has one (e.g. TSCO.LON).
watchlist.add_check_failed: I couldn't check {query} with the data provider ({error}), so I haven't added it.
watchlist.add_no_match: The provider has no instrument matching {query}. Nothing added.
watchlist.add_ambiguous: {query} isn't one exact instrument -- it could be: {options}.
watchlist.add_ambiguous_end: Add the exact symbol you mean. Nothing added.
watchlist.add_ambiguous_ask: Which one? Say its symbol or number ({numbered}). Nothing added yet.
watchlist.add_no_currency: The provider didn't say which currency {symbol} trades in, so I haven't added it.
watchlist.add_not_saved: I tried to add {symbol} but it isn't in the saved watchlist.
watchlist.added: Added {symbol} ({name}, {region}, priced in {currency}) to your watchlist.

alerts.bad_direction: An alert is 'above' or 'below' a price.
alerts.bad_level: The alert needs a positive, finite price, like 300 or 2.5.
alerts.not_watched: {symbol} isn't on your watchlist; add it first.
alerts.wrong_currency: {symbol} is priced in {currency}, not {given}. Give the level in {currency} ({hint}).
alerts.which_currency: Which currency is {level} in? Say it with the currency, e.g. 'alert me if {symbol} goes {direction} {level} {example}' -- {warning}, so I won't guess.

search.failed: I couldn't search the data provider: {error}.

brief.title: # Watchlist brief -- {stamp}
brief.fixture_banner: > **{label}.** Every number below is made up for testing.
brief.obs_line: - **{symbol}** ({name}): {price}; previous close {previous_close}; status **{status}**{stale}; market date {market_date}; retrieved {retrieved}; source: {source}{source_url}{problem}
brief.move_note: - {symbol} moved {change:+.2f}% on its last trading day -- {size} one-day move for a single share. The size alone doesn't say why it moved, and one day says little about the long run.
brief.no_fresh_data: - {symbol}: no fresh data, so nothing to interpret.
brief.empty: Your watchlist is empty, so there's nothing to brief. Add an instrument first, e.g. 'python invest.py add TSCO.LON'.
brief.save_failed: I couldn't save the brief ({error}), so no alert was marked as sent; I'll include it next time.
brief.verify_failed: The brief at {path} didn't match what was fetched, so no alert was marked as sent. The check found: {problems}.
brief.ack_failed: Watchlist brief saved to {path}, but I couldn't record its alerts as sent: {error}.
brief.saved: Full report saved to {path}. {instruments} instrument(s), {alerts} alert(s).
brief.saved_fixture: These are synthetic fixtures, not market data.
brief.check_unreadable: the brief couldn't be read back ({error})
brief.check_line: {symbol}: the saved line doesn't match what was fetched
brief.check_sections: observations and interpretation are not separated
